title: Install native observers on the original admitted route across temporary metadata contention
implementation: Initial subscription/lifecycle/capability/DTMF metadata lookups preserve temporary registry NotReady rather than converting it to forbidden. Native metadata NotReady or Dispatch StorageUnavailable remains authority-busy; other typed errors remain refused. Existing capability-specific typed handling remains intact.

Initial subscription/lifecycle/DTMF observer installation now uses the same original-deadline native_preflight pattern as capability installation. Retry touches only metadata on the already admitted actual route. It does not repeat preparation, signed parameter negotiation, media admission or durable ready commit. Missing/poisoned/unauthorized state cannot supply a grant.
The source lock remains171 and Store schema103. HTTP/OpenAPI and developer lifecycle reference describe this bounded initial-installation boundary.
